text:
lina: quick check-in on the Private setup wizard network step — current mock places breadcrumb below live probe output and it feels noisy, especially on small screens. thoughts? ben: breadcrumb above. users expect navigation at top. also suggest collapsing probe logs to a single-line preview by default with a chevron to expand. :chevron_down: marta: agree. UX detail: when probes auto-run after editing a field the primary action keeps switching between "Run probes" and "Next". propose disabling Next until probes are idle/successful and show a small status pill instead. accessibility-bot: accessibility note: progress updates must be in an aria-live="polite" region and expanding logs should not move keyboard focus. example snippet: ```
Probes: 1/4 passed
``` lina: good catch. also breadcrumb links currently look like primary CTAs. change to muted text + lighter chevrons. add a micro help icon that explains "Back returns to previous step; some step-specific fields may be cleared." ben: technical: debounce auto-probe triggers by 700ms on input changes (CIDR, hostname). show a tiny inline spinner in the field while a probe is queued. if user clicks explicit "Run probes" cancel queued runs and run immediately. devops: FYI staging probe service had a brief spike yesterday at 2025-03-12T03:12:21Z during a test run, ref stg-probe-77. looking into tail latency. marta: keyboard/tab order proposal: breadcrumb -> heading -> primary controls -> progress pill -> details. on mobile collapse breadcrumb into a compact "Step 2 of 5" pill to preserve vertical space. lina: I'll update mocks and add a concise dev checklist: 1) breadcrumb moved above, muted style 2) collapsed logs with "Show details" 3) Next disabled while probes run; clear Run/Cancel states 4) aria-live for progress + focus stability 5) 700ms debounce + field spinner 6) mobile pill variant 7) help tooltip copy tweak. tagging @ben for dev priorities. ben: looks good. one micro copy tweak: change "may be cleared" -> "some fields may be cleared when you go back." clearer for support. lina: done, thanks all!
